(Previous report: https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/229542#issuecomment-4281471434) > > While this issue persisted, I had no choice but to keep manually clicking "Disable protection for 30 seconds" to enable AI Mode on my desktop, and ended up going through the skit of having to use AI Mode on my smartphone with my desktop in front of me for over 4 months. > How long must I continue to experience this discomfort? > > I hope this report will be the last. comment.body:

- `iframe[title="Advertisement"]` was leftover side by side article content.
- `#div:has(> #membrana_video)` is ad video container.
- `.dailymotion-player-root` is positioned at the bottom.

comment.body:
Then `m.11st.co.kr###web2appPopup` will break the site on platforms without scriptlet support.
If on a real device scrolling is not blocked, you can use two element hiding rules

```
m.11st.co.kr###web2appPopup
m.11st.co.kr##.dim
```

If blocked - leave only cookie rule **or** 3 CSS rules. If for blocking/changing one element required at lease one CSS rule, all rules must be css (same type).
